title: Ankhorage Google Ads Provider
summary: Google Ads provider for account-scoped reads and externally approved, durable mutations.
purpose: Connect Google Ads to Ankhorage workflows while keeping every mutation reviewable, explicitly approved, retry-safe, and reconcilable.
responsibilities: Create provider instances for Google Ads reads and mutations.
Persist, claim, execute, and reconcile approved mutation attempts.
Expose the provider through the published MCP integration boundary.
boundaries: Does not autonomously approve or execute unapproved advertising changes.
Does not own generic MCP hosting or approval policy.
Does not expose provider credentials or raw provider failures through portable results.
audience: Applications and automation that need governed access to Google Ads accounts.
Operators reviewing and approving proposed Google Ads mutations.
useCases: Read account-scoped Google Ads data through a configured transport.
Prepare a campaign mutation for external review.
Execute or reconcile a previously approved mutation without duplicate effects.

architecture.role: Provider adapter whose Google-specific transport and authentication sit outside approval-oriented application operations.
invariants: A mutation crosses the provider boundary only after an explicit approval fact.
Durable claims and reconciliation make retried mutation processing observable and bounded.

configuration: Requires Google authentication and account-scoped transport configuration supplied by the host.
security: Mutations require external approval and must not leak credentials or raw provider error payloads.
